blocks.text_bn:
পাঠ ২৩
বর্ণ শিখি : ট ঠ ড ঢ ণ

টব	ট
ঠোঙা	ঠ
ডাব	ড
ঢেউ	ঢ
লবণ	ণ

টব ভরা ফুল গাছে।
ঠোঙা ভরা মুড়ি আছে।
ডাব আনি ঝুড়ি ভরে।
ঢেউ ওঠে নদীর জলে।
লবণ দিলে বাড়বে স্বাদ।
বেশি দিলে বরবাদ।

টমেটো খেতে খুব মজা।
টিয়া পাখির ঠোঁট লাল।
পাখি ডিম পাড়ে।
ঢাল তলোয়ার দেয়ালে সাজানো।
হরিণ দেখতে খুব সুন্দর।

image_slots.compliance_note: single bird letter-exemplar (parrot showing its beak/ঠোঁট) retained per Path B; programmatic stripe post-generation. Keep the bird's head and beak clear of the lower band; no human figures. eyeball pass required at image approval.
image_slots.prompt: A friendly children's-textbook illustration of a single green parrot in side profile, its curved red beak clearly visible, perched on a twig in the upper-central area of the frame with a plain light background. Soft watercolour style, warm daylight. Just the one parrot — no people, no other animals. Flat composition for a young child's reading book. High contrast and clean linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি (পৃ ৩৩, ড): একটি ডিম — object-only। কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only egg illustration; no living being. pass-through untouched in image chain (no stripe).
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of a single egg, its shell partly cracked open, on a plain white background. Soft watercolour style, warm daylight. No people, no animals. Flat front-facing composition for a young child's reading book. High contrast and clean linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি (পৃ ৩৩, ঢ): দেয়ালে সাজানো একটি ঢাল ও একটি তলোয়ার — object-only (S4-resolved, Principal-approved)। যুদ্ধ/সংঘর্ষ নয়, স্থিরভাবে দেয়ালে ঝোলানো সাজসজ্জা। কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: S4 (no C-code) Principal-resolved: a shield and sword arranged/mounted on a wall as static decor (ruling 2b). No combat, no clashing, no figures wielding them; object-only display. NCTB original was a round metal shield alone; sword added to match the approved sentence 'ঢাল তলোয়ার দেয়ালে সাজানো।'. pass-through untouched in image chain (no stripe).
image_slots.prompt: A simple children's-textbook illustration of an ornamental round shield and a straight sword mounted side by side, flat against a plain wall as decoration, crossed or arranged neatly, hanging still. Soft watercolour style, warm daylight. No people, no hands holding them, no animals — just the shield and sword displayed on the wall. Flat front-facing composition for a young child's reading book. High contrast and clean linework so they stay legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: ছবি-দেখি (পৃ ৩৩, ণ): একটি হরিণ — animal letter-exemplar (Path B)। প্রোগ্রাম্যাটিক স্ট্রাইপ প্রযোজ্য; হরিণের দেহ/মুখ স্ট্রাইপের নিচে যেন না পড়ে।
image_slots.compliance_note: single deer letter-exemplar retained per Path B; programmatic stripe post-generation. Keep the deer's body and face clear of the lower band; no human figures. eyeball pass required at image approval.
image_slots.prompt: A friendly children's-textbook illustration of a single spotted deer standing in side profile on a simple grassy ground line, head slightly raised, centered in the frame with a plain light background. Soft watercolour style, warm daylight. Just the one deer — no people, no other animals. Flat composition for a young child's reading book. High contrast and clean linework so it stays legible in black-and-white photocopy.

image_slots.scene_description: বর্ণ-লিখন ট্রেসিং অ্যাসেট (পৃ ৩৩) — ট ঠ ড ঢ ণ, স্ট্রোক-তীরসহ (NCTB মূল)। AI-জেনারেটেড নয়; ভেক্টর অ্যাসেট থেকে অ্যাসেম্বলিতে বসবে।

lessons.notes: পাঠ ২৩ বর্ণ-শিখি: ট ঠ ড ঢ ণ (locked/স্থির), spans NCTB pp.32-33. v2 supersedes v1 (v1 covered only p.32 and had misplaced পড়ি/লিখি; p.33 was not yet supplied). CORRECTION: পড়ি (b09/b10) and লিখি (b11/b12) moved to p.33 where they actually print; p.32 = title + শুনি-ও-বলি only. PAGE 32 (unchanged from v1): ঢাক to ঢেউ spotlight swap (C-03 instrument / C-09 puja) -- word ঢাক to ঢেউ, sentence 'ঢাক বাজে জোরে জোরে।' to 'ঢেউ ওঠে নদীর জলে।'; লবণ kitchen scene (mother + 2 children) to object-only salt-and-food (C-05/C-01); টব/ঠোঙা/ডাব object-only. PAGE 33 (new): ছবি-দেখি words টমেটো/ঠোঁট/ডিম/ঢাল/হরিণ retained. TEXT CHANGE (Principal-approved, S4): the ঢ sentence 'ঢাল তলোয়ার ঝনঝনিয়ে বাজে।' (weapon + clash/সংঘর্ষ + বাজে sound framing) fits NO C-code -> S4 escalation; Principal resolved (ruling: use 'ঢাল তলোয়ার দেয়ালে সাজানো।', তলোয়ার retained as static wall-display vocabulary, ruling 1 confirmed). Combat/clash removed; both words kept. Other p.33 sentences (টমেটো/টিয়া-ঠোঁট/পাখি-ডিম/হরিণ) retained verbatim. IMAGES p.33 (Path B): img-07 ঠোঁট (টিয়া/parrot showing beak) and img-10 হরিণ (deer) kept as single animals + programmatic stripe (contains_living_being:true, generate_stripe), no human figures, eyeball pass at approval; img-06 টমেটো, img-08 ডিম object-only; img-09 ঢ = shield + sword arranged on a wall (S4 ruling 2b) -- static decor, object-only, no figures wielding, NCTB original was shield-alone and the sword is added to match the sentence. Tracing (img-11) = vector_asset on p.33, prompt empty permanently. c_codes now include an S4 marker for the তলোয়ার-line resolution (logged in D-021); C-03/C-09 (ঢাক), C-05 (kitchen figures + p.33 animals), C-01 (kitchen scene) carried from p.32. LETTER AUDIT: b03/b04/b06/b08 oral:true -> EXEMPT; decodable content = letters ট ঠ ড ঢ ণ (b10 read / b12 trace), NCTB-original edited:false -> exempt. No cast figures, refs empty. FLAGGED FOR REVIEWER: (1) confirm the S4 wall-display sword resolution matches intent at sign-off; (2) eyeball the two striped animal slots (parrot beak, deer) so the stripe does not cover identifying detail; (3) confirm ঢ appears as ঢেউ on p.32 and ঢাল on p.33 (intended, different sections).
